data.text: I support 10 tons each, and I’ll commit to that if we all agree. Luke, I appreciate the offer of 12, but I’d rather have an equal share we can sustain than ask three neighbors to take less. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next season, and keeping 50 tons in the lake does that. We can review the catches together each month. Jack, are you willing to join us on the 10-ton cap?
